name: qfs
description: Use when a task needs to read or modify any service the user has connected — mail, files, databases, GitHub, Slack, git, cloud storage — through the qfs pipe-SQL query language and the qfs CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Discover and operate connected services through QFS
interface.longDescription: Use the QFS CLI to discover live connections and available paths, read connected services, and preview authorized writes. Includes Slack public/private channel discovery and thread guidance.
defaultPrompt: Use QFS to discover my connected services and their available paths.
